subject: Consolidated invoicing & onboarding details for renewal + capacity top-up
messages:
From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@tessera.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@tessera.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO attached + billing contact update for renewal + top-up

Hi Hannah / Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Tessera is ready to move forward with the 12-month renewal plus the 20k token capacity top-up we discussed. Procurement asked me to share the PO and confirm a couple of billing details before we route for signature:

- Attached PO (Tessera_PO_4567.pdf) references Redwood invoice terms as Net 60; procurement prefers Net 45 if possible.
- Billing contact should be changed to: Tessera Invoicing Team <procurement@tessera.ai> rather than my personal email.
- Tessera is a Cayman Islands company and procurement will attach a W-8BEN-E — I can add that to the packet once you confirm the correct Redwood payee name and EIN used on invoices.

Can you confirm: payee name, EIN to appear on the invoice, and whether Net 45 is acceptable? Also please advise if you need the PO number embedded in the invoice line items or sent as a separate remittance reference.

Thanks,
Laura Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager | Tessera AI
Attachment: Tessera_PO_4567.pdf (application/pdf, 84 KB)

----
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@tessera.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO attached + billing contact update for renewal + top-up

Laura — thanks for the PO and questions. Quick answers below and copying finance & CS to confirm next steps.

- Payee name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EIN: 45-6789123 (please include this on both the PO and invoice)
- Net terms: we can do Net 45 for this renewal (approved by finance for renewals that include a capacity top-up).
- PO on invoice: please include PO number in the invoice header and add it to the remittance reference so our AR team can apply payment correctly.

Neha / Monica — can you confirm the invoice delivery method Tessera prefers (PDF by email vs. electronic invoicing / EDI) and whether we need any additional tax paperwork on file? Laura indicated W-8BEN-E will be provided.

Aditya — pricing/discount confirmation: can you confirm the top-up is applied to the existing committed capacity bundle and that the renewal start date will be 2027-04-01? If there are any term adjustments beyond Net 45 we should call them out now.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

----
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Kim <laura.kim@tessera.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ar_contacts@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO attached + billing contact update for renewal + top-up

Hi all — looping in AR operations and payments. A few items from finance: 

1) Electronic delivery: we can do PDF invoices to procurement@tessera.ai, but if Tessera prefers ACH/EDI we need a test endpoint and a signed MSA addendum for electronic remittance. Please confirm which you want and provide the EDI/ACH contact.
2) Tax forms: W-8BEN-E is sufficient for withholding status but we need the executed copy on file before we close the deal. Laura — please upload the signed W-8BEN-E to the secure upload link or attach to your reply.
3) Remittance: please include the PO number as the invoice reference and confirm the billing address for Tessera (street, city, postal). If Tessera will route payments from a different payor entity, call that out now.

Action items for Tessera procurement: send signed W-8BEN-E and confirm delivery method (PDF email or EDI). If ACH, provide: bank name, ACH routing, account number, and billing entity name to appear on remittance.

Thanks — Neha Kapoor
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

Laura — confirmed on our side: the 20k top-up will be appended to the existing committed capacity line as an addendum. Renewal effective date 2027-04-01. Pricing unchanged from the quote we reviewed; because you're adding capacity at renewal we are able to extend Net 45 for this term. No additional term concessions required.

Monica will coordinate invoice prep and can add the PO number to the invoice header and remittance line. Monica — please prep a draft invoice (PDF) with the PO number and Net 45 terms and send to procurement@tessera.ai once W-8 is received.

Thanks — Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
